dialect.detail: Micro-Focus COBOL for Windows; uses @OPTIONS compiler directive, COMP-5, STDCALL calling convention, and POINTER data type — all characteristic of Micro-Focus/ACUCOBOL Windows targets. GPL-licensed utility by Federico Priolo / TP ONE SRL.
evidence: CreateProcessA / WaitForSingleObject / CloseHandle Win32 API calls

purpose.domain_detail: Windows process launcher wrapper — calls Win32 CreateProcessA to start an external application, optionally waiting for it to finish (synchronous/asynchronous mode).
purpose.summary: ESEGUI is a COBOL subprogram that wraps the Windows CreateProcessA API to launch an external application. It accepts a command-line string, window-show style, sync/async flag, and returns a success/failure code. If synchronous mode is requested it waits via WaitForSingleObject before returning.

notable_features: COMP-5 binary fields for Win32 struct alignment
POINTER data type for Win32 handle fields
CALL ... WITH STDCALL convention for Win32 API
Win32 API calls: CreateProcessA, WaitForSingleObject, CloseHandle
STARTUPINFO and PROCESSINFO structures mapped in WORKING-STORAGE
verdict.notes: File is UTF-8, fixed format with sequence numbers. The @OPTIONS directive and STDCALL usage strongly indicate Micro-Focus COBOL on Windows. Could also compile under ACUCOBOL-GT which shares similar extensions. No EXEC CICS/SQL. Comment ratio is high (33%) due to extensive header documentation.
